correctness.rationale: Relabeling coordinates along the gcd(n,v) cycles turns chi_{n,v} exactly into d independent copies of ordinary chi on ell=n/d bits. The second explicit family becomes d copies of an affine conjugate A chi_ell A. Known odd-chi order, inverse-degree and differential formulas then transfer. Derivative counts factor across direct-product blocks, giving maximum differential probability exactly 1/4 and differential uniformity 2^(n-2).

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 17 September 2026 source paper partitions a derivative system into arithmetic cycles but does not state the map-level direct-product/affine conjugacy or derive the DDT factorization, differential uniformity, order and inverse-degree consequences. Exact-title, arXiv-ID, formula, decomposition, gcd and differential searches, plus nearby chi literature and the current SCOPE repository, found no prior statement of this package of results. The very recent source creates a material near-simultaneous-discovery risk.

value.rationale: The result gives a concise structural classification of the new low-latency even-dimensional chi permutations: the explicit families are interleavings of independent odd chi blocks. This yields exact cryptographic invariants and shows that every even-dimensional member has a nontrivial invariant coordinate partition under all iterates.
